$schema_note: Sourced parameter set backing the re-derived BioGrid economics. Every entry carries a source key resolvable in REFERENCES.md. Values with source 'ASSUMPTION' are NOT sourced and must not be cited as data.

generation_lcoe_usd_per_mwh._note: Unsubsidized, June 2025 edition (v18). Ranges are Lazard's low-high, not confidence intervals.

pack_price_stationary_usd_per_kwh_2025._note: Cell/pack only. Fell 45% year-on-year; stationary storage became the lowest-priced segment for the first time.

installed_system_cost_usd_per_kwh._note: Utility-scale, including balance-of-system, engineering and installation. Use this, not the pack price, for project capex.

eei_underground_cost_usd_per_mile._note: Overhead-to-underground conversion cost. Low range is distribution-class; high range is the appropriate reference class for HV transmission.

eia_hvdc_usd_per_mile_2017._note: Expressed in 2017 dollars; escalate before use.

escalation_2017_to_2026._note: Approximate general-inflation escalator. Transmission cable and HVDC converter supply chains have inflated faster than CPI since 2021; treat 1.35 as a floor.

derived_usd_per_km_2026._note: EEI high range ($6-12M/mile) converted to km (/1.609) and escalated by 1.35.

overhead_cost_ratio._note: Overhead costs roughly 1/4.5 of buried equivalent. Applied as a sensitivity, not a recommendation.

project_capex_usd_per_kw._note: Reference project: ~3 GW over ~1,500 km at 500 kV.

gb200_nvl72_rack._note: Liquid-cooled. Integrated DLC captures ~98% of heat.

datacenter_facility_cost_usd_per_mw._note: Liquid-cooled shell, power and cooling, excluding IT hardware. Order-of-magnitude only.

nvl72_rack_hardware_cost_usd._note: Street-price estimate; NVIDIA does not publish list pricing.

peri_job_years_per_usd_million._note: Direct + indirect + induced. The lower end applies to capital upgrades, the upper to building operation. These are JOB-YEARS, not simultaneous headcount.

direct_share_of_total_jobs._note: Typical direct fraction of a PERI-style direct+indirect+induced total.

grid_om_fte_per_km_transmission._note: Roughly 1 FTE per 25-50 km of maintained underground circuit. Buried cable needs less routine vegetation and inspection work than overhead, but cable faults are far more labour-intensive to locate and repair.

grid_om_fte_per_substation._note: Maintenance and switching crew per HV substation, shared across nearby sites.

control_room_fte._note: Round-the-clock operations, dispatch and cyber staffing for a regional control centre.

regional_market_denominators._note: Sanity-check denominators. Any claimed annual benefit approaching these totals is not physically available.

michigan_up_retail_sales_mwh_estimate._note: Upper Peninsula only; EIA reports Michigan statewide. Rough allocation.

long_run_demand_growth_to_2050._note: Data center load is the dominant driver.

pilot_scope._note: Physical scope as stated in the original repository documents, held fixed so the re-derivation is comparable to the original claim.

substation_cost_usd._note: HV substation, wide range by voltage class and scope. MISO's Transmission Cost Estimation Guide is the correct reference class for a real estimate.

contingency._note: Standard practice for pre-FEED infrastructure estimates.

original_claims_under_review._note: The figures this re-derivation is testing. Retained verbatim for traceability.
